title.en: Don't Forget to Tame a Pink Elekk Hunter Pet During Brewfest
title.es: No olvides domesticar a una mascota cazadora de Elekk rosa durante el Brewfest

summary.en: Don't Forget to Tame a Pink Elekk Hunter Pet During Brewfest...
summary.es: No olvides domar a una mascota cazadora de Elekk rosa durante el Brewfest...

contentHtml:
Brewfest is here again, giving Beast Mastery Hunters another chance to tame the Pink Elekk pet before it leaves for the year!

Brewfest Holiday Event Guide


A "secret" pet, Hunters won't be able to tame this pachyderm in the Coren Direbrew holiday version of the instance. Instead, the Pink Elekk is found inside the Classic Blackrock Depths dungeon, located in the Burning Steppes. Now that Midnight has made Silvermoon a faction hub, it's easier than ever for players to find their way to the dungeon entrance.

Once inside the dungeon, players need to make their way to The Grim Guzzler bar. Here's how to get to the bar from the dungeon entrance:
  1. From the entrance, go left through the first Shadowforge gate and then immediately right through the second Shadowforge gate.
  2. Head up the slope and take the first East Garrison Door on the left side of the wall.
  3. Once inside the East Garrison, check to make sure the Shadowforge Lock is activated before heading up the ramp. This opens the door to the West Garrison.
  4. After activating the Shadowforge Lock, head up to the ramp and follow the path on the left that connects to the West Garrison.
  5. Take the right-side ramp in the main area of the West Garrison down into the Manufactory area. Once in the Manufactory, take an immediate right, and you will see a bridge leading into the Grim Guzzler.

Tip: Click map to zoom
Blackrock Depths: Shadowforge City

Taming the Pink Elekk

To reveal the Pink Elekk, players need either the Synthebrew Goggles or will need to drink enough alcohol to become sufficiently drunk. Plugger Spazzring offers plenty of Plugger's Blackrock Ale if you do not have the Synthebrew Goggles, but make sure not to accidentally kill him while buying drinks! After having one too many, the Pink Elekk is found just before the ramp leading into the bar on one of the bar tables.



This pet is only available during Brewfest, which runs until October 6th at 10 AM PST. If you missed out on this pet previously, now's your chance to get it!

contentHtml:
The Hall of Thanes is the first new dungeon that Alliance players are likely to encounter in WoW: Forever - take a look at the quests and rewards you'll find inside!

Hall of Thanes Dungeon Guide


New Dungeon: Hall of Thanes

Hall of Thanes is a level 13-18 Dungeon located in Ironforge, in the now-open Old Ironforge portion of the city beneath the High Seat. On the beta, there is a lot of new information on this dungeon and what to expect in terms of loot, experience, and bosses:

  • 5 Quests granting 3900-4900 Experience each
  • 4 Bosses total with fairly good drops, and the final boss is Level 16
  • Very low kill experience on general mobs after the dungeon experience tuning
  • Hard-Hitting Trash Mobs

Hall of Thanes Quests

There are a total of 5 quests for this dungeon. Two are located directly outside the dungeon, two are found in the dungeon, and the final quest, which appears to be the "main" quest, is started in Dun Morogh after looting a Dark Iron Map from a Dark Iron Dwarf. Players can start the quest chain leading to the mobs that drop this item by finding the quest A Visitor to Dun Morogh from Beldin Steelgrill in the Steelgrill Depot.



The 5 Hall of Thanes quests include:
  • Important Heirlooms
  • The Restless Dead
  • Old Ironforge Incursion
  • An Ancient Grudge
  • The Treaty of Understanding
Keep in mind, all these quests are Alliance-only. Notable rewards for the Hall of Thanes quests include:

TypeItemQuest
Two-Hand Mace Ironforge Greathammer Old Ironforge Incursion
Wand Deepblaze Old Ironforge Incursion
Off-Hand Dwarven Tome Important Heirlooms
Cloak Catacomb Cloak An Ancient Grudge

Hall of Thanes Bosses

Hall of Thanes has a total of four bosses:
  1. Faldrim Anvilma (Undead): This boss is fairly easy, but watch the nasty debuff he'll place on your tank. Make sure to clear out trash around him before pulling.
  2. Magmatus (Elemental): Kill the summoner add first, and tank Magmatus away from the rest of the group to mitigate the damage from his AoE.
  3. Plunder (Elemental): His knockback will send you quite far, so make sure no one will be knocked into a trash pack that might wipe the group.
  4. Durgen Dirgehammer (Humanoid): This boss will fear, so make sure to clear out the trash along the edges of the room (but not the golems; those will pull the boss). Killing a golem and then wiping doesn't make the golem respawn, so if you're facing an inevitable wipe, burn down a golem to make the next pull easier.


One notable piece of loot from the final boss is this powerful one-handed axe: Durgen's Crescent Axe!

Hall of Thanes Trash

The trash here is not complex; however, it does hit pretty hard! Players without any sort of crowd control, especially entering at a lower level, may struggle to kill some of these packs, especially towards the final boss, as the damage output is no joke.

contentHtml:
Blizzard has posted hotfixes for today which includes a 12% Single Target buff to Unholy DKs due to a bug fix.

Blizzard recently buffed Blightfall in the recent class tuning, but the ability was bugged and doing less damage than intended. This has now been fixed and results in:
  • Single Target: 12% buff from this bug fix alone, 15% compared to last week.
  • AoE: 6% buff from this bug fix alone, 7% compared to last week.
Blizzard
View Original

Hotfixes

September 23, 2026

Classes
  • Death Knight
    • Unholy
      • Resolved an issue with Blightfall doing less damage as more time passes since the plague was applied.
  • Monk
    • Windwalker
      • Fixed an issue that caused PvP adjustments to Windwalker’s Celestial Conduit and Flurry Strikes to apply in PvE as well.
Delves
  • Fixed issue where Valeera becomes unable to change talents and gain abilities after a faction change. Players experiencing this will need to enter a delve on the affected character, then leave the delve, and then log out to correct the issue.

title.es: ¿Qué es World of Warcraft: Forever? - Vídeo oficial

summary.es: ¿Qué es World of Warcraft: Forever? - Video oficial...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has released a new YouTube video explaining how World of Warcraft: Forever is different from Retail & Classic WoW.

Summary

Intro
  • Forever is not replacing Modern or Classic WoW.
  • WoW is putting an emphasis on the level-up journey and discovering new adventures on the way to max level.
  • Earn account-wide rewards that make your journey more impactful and rewarding.
  • There are new dungeons, quests, zones, raids, and tradeskill recipes.
  • The inspiration came from Season of Discovery.
  • Forever takes the feeling of discovery and expands it.
Riverglades
  • A new fork in Redridge Mountains now leads to the Riverglades.
  • Alliance players will connect with the Brotherhood of the Horse.
  • Horde players will meet the Boulderrock Ogre clan.
  • Players will encounter the Twilight's Hammer here.
Hyjal
  • Serves as the finale of the leveling journey.
  • Both raids will be found here.
  • There's a mixed Horde and Alliance camp who were forced into an uneasy peace after getting trapped.
Other Features
  • The Skyborne are a new race with their own racials and they choose to be Horde or Alliance.
  • Other new races include Dwarf Shamans, Gnome Priests, Human Hunters, Orc Mages, Troll Warlocks, and Forsaken Paladins.
  • As you level, there will be new and reimagined dungeons.

title.en: SPOILERS: Possible Legendary Information Datamined in WoW: Forever
title.es: SPOILERS: Posible información legendaria recopilada en WoW: Forever

summary.en: SPOILERS: Possible Legendary Information Datamined in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: SPOILERS: Posible información legendaria recopilada en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
WoW: Forever has a new Legendary questline coming in Spring 2027, and we may have datamined a lot of details about the questline and what it could be!

WoW: Forever Roadmap
More Information:
Information in this article is based on datamining the game files. WoW: Forever handles datamining and encryption differently than other versions of WoW, so please note that all of the following information is subject to change on Forever's launch. Parts of this article are speculation based on the data that was found.
During BlizzCon 2026, Blizzard revealed the 2026/2027 roadmap for WoW: Forever, which provides an overview of the next 12 months. Listed under Spring 2027, Blizzard lists "New Legendary Questline," which many players are hyped for. We don't officially know more about it yet, so many players have been speculating as to what, if anything, a new legendary might be.



We’ve now datamined many details about the potential Legendary weapon. Spoilers ahead if you want to keep reading!

Legendary Questline Datamining

Datamining has revealed some interesting information about possible steps for the Legendary questline. Most of the Legendary's data (its quests, items, spells, the Archimonde map, and the boss fight) is encrypted, so we're working from what's readable around it.

We’ve datamined that the Legendary likely has 3 stages during the questline, each with its own tracking quest. This is relevant for linking the Legendary to some spells that may otherwise be unrelated.

These findings are in no particular order. As this is datamining, this is unconfirmed and can be changed at any point.

Locations

Some locations have associated quests that indicate where some steps of the Legendary questline will likely take place.

  • 1.60 Legendary - Moonglade - Barrow Dens - Satyr - Conversation
  • 1.60 Legendary - Un’Goro Pylon Puzzle Solved
  • 1.60 Legendary - Solo Encounter Completed (Tracking Quest)
  • 1.60 Legendary - Solo Encounter Completed (Tracking Quest)
  • 1.60 Legendary - Solo Encounter Completed (Tracking Quest) 2


From these notes, it seems like some steps of the Legendary chain will occur in Moonglade and Un’Goro, with a puzzle taking place in Un’Goro.

Solo Encounter

There is another interesting finding in the ScreenEffect database.

1.60.0 - Legendary - Solo Encounter - Archimonde - Darken Skies


We've also datamined that the solo encounter for the Legendary takes place in a zone called "Archimonde's Fall". In the original The Burning Crusade expansion, players participated in and witnessed the death of Archimonde at the World Tree at Hyjal Summit, through the Caverns of Time, and this time players might need to do it solo under a darkening sky.

This matches the above datamining and indicates that there is likely a solo encounter step, and indicates the likely enemy: Archimonde!

A Ritual

We’ve also found mentions of an Elune Ritual that are likely related to the Legendary.

These spells likely mean that this Ritual takes place after you obtain the 1st stage of the weapon and is required to get to the 2nd step.

Stormwraith

Another spell mentions charging the “Branch” with the power of Stormwraith.

Stormcharged
Instant
Charges the branch of Nordrassil with the power of Stormwraith.


What is Stormwraith? From the Everlasting Bond and Everlasting Bond spells, Stormwraith shares health with Sylvestris Dusksong, and Sylvestris Dusksong is listed as a boss in the Hyjal raid. This seems to indicate that you will need to do the Hyjal raid as part of the Legendary questline, but it is possible that there might be an alternate Stormwraith in a scenario or dungeon.

New Faction

Finally, we have Cenarion Circle (Legendary Event) a brand new Cenarion Circle faction that is named to be related to the Legendary event. This isn't a real reputation in the sense that players will grind rep; it's simply a faction that NPCs belong to.

Professions

The data indicates that Professions will play a role in the quest process, but most of the items and files related to this are encrypted. We can see that encrypted files exist, but not specifically what they are.

The portion that isn't encrypted, though, indicates that each crafting profession will create a reagent item for the quest. For example, Engineers will need to provide some type of parts, while the others aren't as specific. From what we can see regarding triggers on the quest state, it looks like six checks are attached to the quest, meaning it won't just be one or two required reagents - it would require one being contributed from all.

Conclusion

Putting it all together, what do we get? We speculate that this is a Healer-only legendary that is made from a branch of Nordrassil with 3 stages. The quest chain takes you through:
  • The Barrow Dens, with a Satyr in Moonglade
  • A Pylon Puzzle in Un’Goro
  • An Elune Ritual
  • Charging the Branch with Stormwraith’s power in Hyjal
  • Ending in a solo fight against Archimonde in Archimonde’s Fall
However, there is an item, NOT USED, that may indicate one particular Healer spec is being left out. Keep in mind, this is speculation at this time, and Blizzard has not confirmed or given details about any of this. However, this item doesn't mention Paladins at all, and if the Legendary is a branch of Nordrassil, that may mean it is a Dagger or Staff - which Paladins can't use. If it were a mace, Paladins might be included, but based on the speculation from that item, it's potentially not. It is also worth noting that, while an argument could be made that this is a caster DPS legendary, it then wouldn't make sense for Mages or Warlocks to be missing, despite Shadow Priest, Balance Druid, and Elemental Shaman being covered by that item. As this is datamined, it could be incorrect or subject to change, particularly since this item is clearly labeled as NOT USED.

Even though quite a bit of this is something we've been able to find, Blizzard has kept a massive amount of this data truly encrypted. They've been very clear that the intended design of Forever is to encourage social connections, exploration, and finding things out together as a community, and this still feeds into that - without any other information, the best we can do is speculate, and this information could be entirely different (or outright removed!) on launch.
